agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor McGrath called the regular February 3, 2009 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:05 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: Council discussion regarding revised agenda.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion failed 3:6, Ageton, Espinoza and Wilson in support.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The Mayor indicated that public participation would re-open at the conclusion of item 5B and that item 8A-1 (the potential call-up of the use and site review for Washington Village) would then be addressed by council prior to other matters.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM JANUARY 13, 2009.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO RATIFY COUNCIL REGIONAL COMMITTEE APPOINTMENTS AND OTHER ASSIGNMENTS FOR 2009.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was rescheduled for February 17 to address vacancies created by the resignation of Shaun McGrath.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF LAW FOR THE DENIAL OF THE SITE REVIEW APPLICATION FOR THE 1580 CANYON BOULEVARD PROJECT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Members Espinoza and Wilson voted in opposition to this item.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7638, APPROVING CERTAIN BENEFIT CHANGES AND TAX COMPLIANCE AMENDMENTS CONTINGENT UPON FIRE AND POLICE PENSION ASSOCIATION (FPPA) APPROVAL AND REQUESTING FPPA APPROVAL OF THE CHANGES TO THE CITY OF BOULDER “OLD HIRE” FIRE DEFINED BENEFIT PLAN (OHFDBP).
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO.7639 TO ESTABLISH A BUSINESS INCENTIVE REBATE PROGRAM BY AMENDING CHAPTERS 3-2, “SALES AND USE TAX,” 3-8, “DEVELOPMENT EXCISE TAX,” AND 4-20, “FEES,” B.R.C. 1981 AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO GRANT TAX AND FEE REBATES TO PROMOTE ECONOMIC VITALITY AND TO MAKE RULES RELATED THERETO AS PART OF A BUSINESS INCENTIVE PROGRAM, INCLUDING A PROPOSED BUSINESS MICROLOAN PROGRAM AND THE ONGOING PARKS AND RECREATION EMPLOYEE DISCOUNT PROGRAM.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE DESIGNATING THE BUILDING AND SITE AT 896 17 TH STREET, TO BE KNOWN ALSO AS THE HAMPTON-BARNES HOUSE, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY OF BOULDER HISTORIC PRESERVATION CODE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF MOTION TO PUBLISH BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE TO PERMIT USEABLE OPEN SPACE AND PARKING WITHIN THE PUBLIC RIGHTS-OF-WAY TO BE INCLUDED IN THE SITE ZONING CALCULATIONS FOR THE PURPOSE OF PERMITTING THE PROPOSED DENSITY FOR THE BOULDER MOBILE MANOR PROJECT LOCATED AT 2637 VALMONT ROAD WITHIN THE RH-4 (HIGH DENSITY RESIDENTIAL) ZONING DISTRICT. THE ORDINANCE IS REQUESTED AS A RESULT OF THE REQUIRED DEDICATION OF PUBLIC RIGHTS-OF-WAY THROUGH THE PROPERTY CONNECTING VALMONT ROAD WITH ARNETT ROAD.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

agenda_items.title: CALL- UP CHECK IN
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Deputy Mayor Gray indicated an interest in calling up the Washington Village site review.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS

SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7640 DESIGNATING THE BUILDING AND A PORTION OF THE SITE AT 1777 BROADWAY STREET, TO BE KNOWN ALSO AS THE MUNICIPAL BUILDING, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY OF BOULDER HISTORIC PRESERVATION CODE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO PROVIDE DIRECTION TO STAFF ON NEXT STEPS IN PLANNING FOR THE POTENTIAL REVITALIZATION OF THE UNIVERSITY HILL BUSINESS DISTRICT.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
GRANDVIEW UPDATE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Brautigam reviewed the correspondence that had taken place to date with CU regarding the proposed building on Grandview.

agenda_items.title: UPDATE ON FEDERAL LOBBYING EFFORTS, BILLS INTRODUCED IN THE COLORADO GENERAL ASSEMBLY AND CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENTS TO THE CITY’S 2009 STATE AND FEDERAL LEGISLATIVE AGENDA.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 9:0.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY: - None.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: None.

agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS

Washington Village II Site Review #LUR2008-00083: Redevelopment of the existing Washington Elementary School Site as a mixed-use co-housing community consisting of 33 dwelling units, approximately 2,950 square feet of commercial/office space, and accessory co-housing facilities on the three-acre site zoned both Residential High Density – 2 (RH-2) and Residential Low Density – 1 (RL -1). The applicant also requests vested rights pursuant to Section 9-2-19, B.R.C. 1981. WIP date: January 28, 2009. Last opportunity for call up is February 8, 2009. Approved with conditions (4-1, E. agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 5:4; Ageton, Espinoza, McGrath and Wilson opposed.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO CALL A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING AT 5:00 P.M. ON MARCH 10, 2009 TO MAKE FORMAL BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS APPOINTMENTS.

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS: Action on motions made under Matters.

agenda_items.title: ITEMS RELATING TO THE MAYOR
Formal resignation of the Mayor
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor McGrath said a few parting words as he formally resigned from the Boulder City Council to take a position as part of President Obama’s team in Washington D.C.

agenda_items.title: Appointment of Mayor and Deputy Mayor
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Appelbaum was elected to serve as Mayor through the term that expires November of 2009.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 12:03 A.M.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Ageton, to remove item 11B from the agenda and bring it back on February 17.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 3:6, Ageton, Espinoza and Wilson in support.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to approve consent agenda items 3A and 3C through 3G with item 3B pulled to allow appointments to positions vacated by Mayor McGrath to come back at the next meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 9:0 with council members Espinoza and Wilson opposed to item 3C.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Osborne, to adopt Ordinance No. 7640 designating the building and a portion of the site at 1777 Broadway Street, to be known also as the Municipal Building, as an individual landmark under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code.

Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to approve the staff recommended motion on page 2 of the agenda memo as follows: Motion directing staff to move forward on planning for the revitalization of the Uni-Hill Business District as follows: A. Initiate a short-term effort to be completed by June 2009: 1. Refine the draft problem statement, goals and objectives (see page 15 for initial draft) based on Planning Board's December 18, 2008 feedback and City Council's feedback February 3, 2009 to provide direction for the work plan in item 4 below. 2. Continue with the work underway to address use/alcohol issues (scheduled for an April 2009 City Council study session). 3. Make minor changes to the Land Use Code for presentation to Planning Board for recommendation and City Council for action including: • Exempt all below grade space from the Floor Area Ratio (FAR) calculations (currently 50 % of habitable below grade space is calculated in the allowable FAR). • Consider minor changes to the Business Main Street (BMS) zone and the University Hill General Improvement District (UHGID) boundary 4. Prepare a work plan and schedule for a comprehensive revitalization strategy for direction from Planning Board and City Council, that includes those key issues identified by Planning Board, listed on page 3 of this memo. This would require consulting with the New Hill Company and other stakeholders. B. Initiate development of a comprehensive revitalization strategy, process and schedule, as developed in item d-4 above (to be initiated in 2010).
Council Member Ageton offered a friendly amendment to amend the recommendation to state no later than 2010.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 11:05 p.m.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Espinoza to amend the city’s 2009 State and Federal Legislative Agenda as outlined in attachment B of the staff memo.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to call-up the Washington Village II Site Review.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 5:4; Ageton, Espinoza, McGrath and Wilson opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to call a special meeting on March 10 at 5:00 p.m. to make formal Boards and Commissions appointments.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 11:30 p.m.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Cowles to open the nominations for Mayor.
Deputy Mayor Gray nominated Matt Appelbaum for Mayor.
motions.vote_text: Votes for Matt Appelbaum - 5 ( Appelbaum Cowles, Gray, Morzel, and Osborne).

motions.motion_text: Council Member Ageton nominated Ken Wilson for Mayor.
motions.vote_text: Vote for Ken Wilson - 3 (Wilson, Ageton and Espinoza)

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 12:03 A.M.
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 12:03 A.M.

open_comment_speakers.name: Steven Toot

open_comment_speakers.name: Tanya Petty
